repo: cipher-box GSD phases store their planning docs under .planning/phases/<phase-id>/, with per-phase RESEARCH and VALIDATION markdown files (e.g. 70.1-VALIDATION.md) generated from a shared template plus phase-specific research content.
workflow: In this GSD workflow, VALIDATION.md is derived by merging the standard template with the 'Validation Architecture' section already produced in the phase's RESEARCH doc, rather than being written from scratch.
